cross_cutting._note: GBP 11.5m of directorate/service savings closes the GBP 23.4m 2026/27 challenge (with GBP 9.7m council tax + GBP 2.2m tax-base growth); engine risk-adjusts the platform programme to ~GBP 7.26m EV.

mtfs_period: MTFS gap GBP 78m over five years (2026/27 to 2030/31); the 2026/27 GBP 23.4m challenge is resolved

reserves._note: General reserves GBP 16.3m (5.4% of net budget); MTFS adds GBP 2m/yr top-up. New Adults Placement Risk Reserve GBP 1.9m.

risks.risk: MTFS gap GBP 78m over five years (2026/27 to 2030/31), with a GBP 23.4m challenge closed for 2026/27 (GBP 11.5m savings + GBP 9.7m council tax + GBP 2.2m tax-base). Reform UK inherits a Labour-set budget; the first Reform-set budget is 2027/28. NOT under intervention (the report explicitly contrasts Wakefield with neighbours Leeds and Bradford, both on EFS).

DSG High Needs Block in a GBP 4.1m deficit (2025/26 forecast), managed by a schools-block-to-HNB cross-subsidy (not a Safety Valve / High Needs Stability Grant authority); the statutory-override DSG-deficit-on-balance-sheet risk applies as the override approaches. HNB allocation GBP 67.6m (+3.5m).
Adult Social Care carries the largest single saving (GBP 4.0m 'Maximising Independence'); demand-led delivery risk, partly mitigated by the new GBP 1.9m Adults Placement Risk Reserve.

_inherited_budget_note: Set by the outgoing Labour administration (2 Mar 2026). Reform UK won 7 May 2026 (ended Labour control held since 1974) and inherits delivery; the first Reform-set budget will be 2027/28.
_net_budget_note: 2026/27 net budget GBP 431.4m (up from 302.5m in 25/26; the GBP 129m jump is a Fair Funding Review restatement - GBP 97.8m of grants rolled into RSG + a business-rates baseline reset - NOT real growth; underlying service spend is broadly flat).
